name: Luma Notifications → Slack Summary
description: Polls Gmail hourly for Luma notifications, filters out sensitive emails (by sender, keyword, Gmail label, or attachment) before any content reaches the AI, summarizes the rest, and posts to Slack.

filters.q: from:(luma.com OR lu.ma OR notifications@lu.ma) newer_than:1d

options.systemMessage: You are summarizing Luma event-notification emails for a Slack channel. Write a concise, friendly summary with a short bullet for each notable item (RSVPs, reminders, new events, cancellations). Use Slack markdown. Keep it under 12 lines.
